title: Number of Ships in a Rectangle
description: Count the number of ships in a rectangular area using a Sea API.

steps.note: Checking entire area (0,0) to (2,2). Ships exist.
Splitting area into quadrants at mid (1,1).
Recursive call on bottom-left quadrant (0,0) to (1,1).
Recursive call on top-right quadrant (2,2) to (2,2).
